name: bootty
description: Alternative terminal for VS Code powered by Ghostty's terminal emulation (libghostty-vt) via WebAssembly

scripts.bench:e2e: npm -C ../packages/ghostty-web run build && npm -C ../packages/libghostty-webgl run build && npm run build && node scripts/run-bench-e2e.mjs

bootty.fontFamily.description: Font family for BooTTY. Leave empty to use editor.fontFamily.

bootty.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels. Set to 0 to use editor.fontSize.

bootty.scrollback.description: Scrollback buffer size in lines. Set to 0 to use terminal.integrated.scrollback.

bootty.defaultTerminalLocation.description: Where new terminals open by default

bootty.shell.description: Optional shell path for BooTTY terminals. Leave empty to use the system default.

bootty.shellArgs.description: Arguments passed to the shell when launching BooTTY terminals. Example: ["--norc", "--noprofile"].

bootty.bell.description: Bell notification style. 'visual' shows a flash and status bar notification, 'none' disables all bell feedback.

bootty.notifications.description: Show VS Code notifications from terminal applications (OSC 9 escape sequences).

enumDescriptions: Use WebGL2 if available, fall back to Canvas
Force Canvas2D (useful for debugging or compatibility)
bootty.renderer.description: Rendering backend for terminal display. WebGL2 provides better performance for large terminals.

bootty.debugLog.description: Debug log namespaces (comma-separated). Examples: 'bootty:*' for all, 'bootty:webgl:*' for WebGL only, 'bootty:webgl:render,bootty:webgl:cellbuffer' for specific modules. Leave empty to disable. Note: Reload the webview (Developer: Reload Webview) after first enabling to capture early initialization logs.

bootty.pty.maxLinesPerFrame.description: Maximum number of newline-delimited lines written per animation frame. Set to 0 for auto (rows - 1). Lower values reduce full redraws during heavy output.

bootty.pty.maxFrameMs.description: Optional time budget (ms) for PTY draining per animation frame. Set to 0 to disable. When set, PTY drain stops once the budget is exceeded, even if maxLinesPerFrame allows more.

bootty.pty.maxBytesPerFrame.description: Optional byte budget for PTY draining per animation frame. Set to 0 to disable. When set, PTY drain stops once the budget is exceeded, even if maxLinesPerFrame allows more.

bootty.pty.flushFastPathBytes.description: Use a microtask flush when the PTY queue byte size is at or below this threshold. Set to 0 to disable the fast path.

bootty.pty.flushFastPathSegments.description: Use a microtask flush when the PTY queue segment count is at or below this threshold. Set to 0 to disable the fast path.

bootty.pty.adaptiveDrain.description: Enable adaptive PTY draining when the queue backlog grows beyond the configured threshold.

bootty.pty.adaptiveFrameMs.description: Time budget (ms) used for adaptive PTY draining when backlog exceeds the threshold.

bootty.pty.adaptiveQueueThreshold.description: Queue segment count threshold that triggers adaptive PTY draining.

bootty.pty.adaptiveAutoTune.description: Dynamically adjust adaptive drain maxLines per frame to meet the frame time budget.

bootty.pty.adaptiveMinBytesPerFrame.description: Minimum bytes drained per frame while adaptive draining is active. Set to 0 to disable the minimum.

bootty.pty.adaptiveQueueBytesThreshold.description: Optional queue byte threshold that triggers adaptive PTY draining. Set to 0 to use the segment threshold instead.

bootty.pty.adaptiveQueueHysteresisRatio.description: When adaptive draining activates, keep it active until the queue falls below threshold * ratio. Set to 0 to disable hysteresis.

bootty.pty.adaptiveMaxLinesPerFrame.description: Override maxLinesPerFrame when adaptive draining is active. Set to 0 to keep the normal maxLinesPerFrame behavior.

bootty.pty.adaptiveMaxLinesPerFrameWebgl.description: Override adaptiveMaxLinesPerFrame when using the WebGL renderer. Set to 0 to use the normal adaptiveMaxLinesPerFrame.

bootty.pty.outputBatchMaxBytes.description: Max PTY output bytes to batch before posting to the webview. Set to 0 to disable size-based batching. Set both outputBatchMaxBytes and outputBatchMaxDelayMs to 0 to disable batching.

bootty.pty.outputBatchMinBytes.description: Minimum PTY output bytes to batch before posting to the webview. Small payloads are padded to this size to avoid postMessage drops. Set to 0 to disable the size floor (small messages may be dropped).

bootty.pty.outputBatchMaxDelayMs.description: Max delay (ms) before flushing batched PTY output to the webview. Set to 0 to flush on next tick. Set both outputBatchMaxBytes and outputBatchMaxDelayMs to 0 to disable batching.

bootty.pty.outputBatchMaxPendingMs.description: Max time (ms) to keep batched PTY output waiting when below outputBatchMinBytes. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely for min bytes.

bootty.pty.outputAckMaxBytes.description: Max PTY output bytes to require an ack from the webview. Set to 0 to disable ack retries for all messages.

bootty.pty.outputAckRetryMs.description: Retry delay (ms) for PTY output acks. Set to 0 to disable ack retries.

bootty.pty.outputAckMaxAttempts.description: Max resend attempts for PTY output when ack is missing. Set to 0 to disable ack retries.

bootty.profile.outputPath.description: Optional path for renderer profiling output (JSONL). If set, BooTTY writes to this path in addition to the default log location. Use a directory to auto-name the file. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root.
